prose.summary: Reconciled source purposes: [1] Define the Editor as an ordinary MetaModule under nanoCMS, governed by AccessCore and capable of self-editing only through copy-validate-activate semantics with a recovery path. [2] Define the Expose Editor itself as a normal MetaModule placed under nanoCMS, with its own internal editor sections/views organized by the same nanoCMS structure and a safe copy-validate-activate recovery path.

semantics.ac_rule: AC off means no AccessCore restrictions; AC on governs Editor and its subareas through normal policy.
semantics.activation_rule: Only validated candidate may become active.
semantics.layout_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Editor internal navigation/layout is represented through nanoCMS site/page structure. [2] Editor internal navigation/layout is represented by nanoCMS site/page structure.
semantics.module_rule: Editor is a normal MetaModule, not a privileged runtime class.
semantics.no_bypass_rule: Editor has no privileged AC/runtime bypass.
semantics.placement_rule: Editor is placed/bound through nanoCMS like other outward-facing MetaModules.
semantics.recovery_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] A bootstrap/recovery path remains available if the candidate Editor is invalid. [2] A bootstrap/recovery path remains available if candidate Editor configuration is invalid.
semantics.self_edit_rule: Reconciled source clauses: [1] Running Editor edits/validates a candidate copy rather than irreversibly mutating the only active definition. [2] Running Editor edits a candidate/copy of its own MetaModule/structure rather than irreversibly mutating the only active definition.
semantics.spa_rule: Editor may present SPA-style UI over normal canonical operations/REST bindings.
